tasks.description: Migrate object storage from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage for both web and worker modules

All S3 storage operations (list, upload, download, delete) have been replaced with Azure Blob Storage equivalents. Build passes, all unit tests pass, and no security vulnerabilities detected.
